# dodopayments_credit_entitlements (Data Source)

Lists credit entitlements.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dodopayments_credit_entitlements" "example" {
  max_items = 10
}

output "credit_entitlements" {
  value = data.dodopayments_credit_entitlements.example.items
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `deleted` (Boolean) List deleted credit entitlements.
- `locale` (String) Shows the translated name, description and unit of the catalog entities in this
locale. The value must be a code from `GET /locales`, for example `fr`.
A field with no translation, an unknown code, or no code shows the base text.

Do not send a text from a localized response back in a create or update request.
The base text then changes to the translated text.
- `max_items` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. The default is 1000.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The credit entitlements that the API returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
